title: What If You Couldn't Feel Pain?
description:
No headaches, no stubbed toes, no paper cuts. Some people are really born unable to feel pain, and it's one of the most dangerous conditions on Earth. Meet the woman who didn't need painkillers after surgery, find out what happens to a body with no alarm system, and how these rare genes are helping build the painkillers of the future.

If you could switch pain off, would you? Tell me in the comments 👇

▶ More What Ifs: What If You Could Never Forget Anything?
